subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should #27526 remain the canonical broad WebChat conversation-management and multi-AI collaboration tracker, or should it be split/closed in favor of narrower project, topic, and multi-agent issues?
rationale: Current main implements a useful flat-session subset, while the remaining work defines product/API boundaries across WebChat, Gateway session metadata, project isolation, and multi-agent orchestration.

options.title: Keep as canonical umbrella
options.body: Keep #27526 open as the broad tracker and link narrower implementation issues for project/topic organization and multi-agent collaboration milestones.

options.title: Split and close umbrella
options.body: Close #27526 after moving remaining requirements into narrower canonical issues such as projects, topic UI, and multi-agent orchestration.

options.title: Defer collaboration scope
options.body: Keep only session/project organization in OpenClaw core and route committee/meeting workflows to plugins or future RFC work.

recommendation.title: Keep as canonical umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep #27526 open as the broad tracker and link narrower implementation issues for project/topic organization and multi-agent collaboration milestones.

likelyOwner.reason: As project owner and author of the recent partial session-thread implementation, steipete is the best available owner for choosing whether this stays an umbrella tracker.
